note_en: 越来越 + adjective or verb means "more and more," a quality that keeps growing: 中国人的寿命越来越长 "Chinese people are living longer and longer"; 记性越来越差 "his memory is getting worse and worse"; 自己的闹钟越来越多 "she has more and more alarms." Don't confuse it with 越 A 越 B "the more A, the more B," which links two different qualities.
